messages:
Michele B: Heads-up: I've been tracking a steady trickle of fncall schema rejects that are turning into degen fallbacks in eu-central. Low volume but recurring for a single integration.
Samir D: I saw that on the validation heatmap. Small org_id spike around 07:10 UTC. Can you paste a sanitized example?
Michele B: Example (sanitized):
```json
{"session_id":"s_77","tool_output":{"items":[{"line":1,"text":"ok"}]}}
```
Michele B: Validator expects tool_output to be object with metadata. Some clients send minimal arrays.
ops-bot: Alert: fncall_schema_reject_rate (eu-central) > 1% for 15m. Paging @eng-platform. https://console/redwood/alerts/1201
Yara N: Two quick asks: 1) can we avoid routing these to degen while we patch the client? 2) can Console show the mismatch diff and a redacted payload sample?
Samir D: For (1) we have per-account feature flags. We can flip validation.soft=true for that org for a short window. That prevents degen routing. Low risk.
Ben F: For billing, finance flagged that fallbacks routed to degen are billed as full fncall. If we soft-validate and no tool executes, should we bill full? They want guidance.
Michele B: Ops proposal: emit trace tag validation_mode=soft|hard and validation_result=coercible|noncoercible. Then Console and billing can make decisions.
Yara N: Also need a Console widget: "Schema Diagnostics" under fncall that shows top-5 mismatched fields, percent by cause, and one scrubbed example per cause. UX should have a toggle to reveal full diff.
Samir D: Short-term plan: 1) flip per-org soft flag for org_x for 2h; 2) bump sampling of failed validations from 1% -> 15% for those requests so we capture model_decodes; 3) emit trace tags validation_mode and validation_result; 4) add incident note.
Ben F: Finance will accept an interim rule: if validation_mode=soft AND route!=executed_tool then mark units as "fallback_discount" until policy finalized. We'll reconcile after postmortem.
Michele B: Implemented the flag flip and sampling bump. Early results: fallback events from org_x dropped 90% within 10m.
Yara N: Filing a Console ticket for the widget and will mock the UI. Link will be added here.
Samir D: Follow-ups: add metric fncall_validation_outcome{hard,soft,coercion} next sprint, and SDK docs update for tool_output unions.
Michele B: Thanks everyone. Monitoring for 1h then revert flag if stable. :white_check_mark:
